title: Respiratory referral documentation

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports clinician-led emergency, family-medicine, and pulmonary referral according to the documented cough context.
user_facing_items.population: People presenting with cough; age limits are not stated in the applicability section.
user_facing_items.setting: Telehealth services in DHA-licensed health facilities.
restrictions: Direct for Dubai telehealth cough documentation; only partial for a general in-person workflow and for chronic-cough investigation pathways.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports review of alternative or comorbid causes, adherence, inhaler technique, smoking, occupational, psychosocial and environmental factors, treatment response, device review, and clinician-led referral.
user_facing_items.population: People presenting with suspected or established asthma in the populations specified by the guideline.
user_facing_items.setting: Telehealth services in DHA-licensed health facilities.
restrictions: Direct for Dubai telehealth asthma documentation; emergency management and controlled-medicine prescribing are excluded and in-person use remains partial.
user_facing_items.rationale: Supports uncontrolled-asthma review and referral context for respiratory referral documentation; no decision is generated.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports chest radiography, spirometry with reversibility, sputum testing where infection is suspected, selected inflammatory markers, specialist referral for persistent or unclear cough, and upper-airway specialist assessment when indicate
user_facing_items.population: Adults with chronic cough lasting more than 8 weeks.
user_facing_items.setting: Primary and specialist assessment of chronic cough.
restrictions: Exact for adult chronic cough assessment and referral; not applicable to children and not directly validated for UAE pathways.
user_facing_items.rationale: Supports adult chronic-cough investigation and referral context for respiratory referral documentation; no decision is generated.
